arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: John Roberts argued Congress conditioned funding on record privacy.
He stated Congress did not phrase this as individual rights.
Ms. Brinkmann argued Congress gave parents the right to prevent release.
She cited the statute's words, structure, and history.
